name: Signature Pad
description: A paper area you sign with a brush: ink thickens when you slow down, thins when you hurry and bleeds a little where each stroke begins. A Type instead switch lets anyone without a pointer type their name, set in a script hand.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called after each finished stroke, Undo and Clear, and when Type instead is switched. A stroke is an array of { x, y, time, pressure? } in CSS pixels from the paper's top left. While a typed name stands in for the drawing it is called with no strokes.

props.name: onNameChange
props.description: Called as the typed name changes, with the name trimmed, and with an empty string when Type instead is switched off. With the switch on, the name typed on the line is the signature; it is set in a script face from the system and toDataURL() draws it.

props.name: color
props.description: Ink colour. Any CSS colour or token; it is read again when the theme changes.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the paper in pixels. The width fills the container.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Dims the pad and ignores input.

props.name: ref
props.description: toDataURL(type?, quality?) returns the ink (or the typed name) alone on a transparent background at twice the size; also clear(), undo(), isEmpty(), strokes() and name().

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Other div props are passed through.
